hitl_conditions: AI suggestions (non-conformity causes, material requests, assembly sequences) require operator/warehouse-worker confirmation before robots execute; as low value-added tasks are automated, blue-collar staff move from operational to control roles, conditional on change management, training and coaching.
key_finding: Fincantieri's shipyard 'twin of twins' (data, visualisation, AI simulation) is being deployed across planning, production and logistics/supply chain, with AI algorithms for weld inspection, sheet placement, truck scheduling/reordering and GenAI operator agents; AI proposes, operators confirm, and change management/training are treated as decisive for adoption.

quotes.text: This digital twin is a model that represents both the product (ship) and the production process. This initiative is driven by the need to address labor shortages and enhance control during ship construction.

Simulation (AI): the digital model enables on which analyses and simulation scenarios can be performed with the AI to make better decisions. For example, in the event of a production issue, the simulation provides supervisors with the ability to decide
quotes.section: Sec. 2 Digital Twin: Vision & concept, p. 1139 (PDF page 3)

quotes.text: Logistics systems are in place for the digitization of the transport bill and the scheduling of the arrival of trucks for the management of materials through an artificial intelligence algorithm, optimizing the reordering of materials
quotes.section: Sec. 3.1.3 Logistics & Supply Chain, p. 1142 (PDF page 6)

quotes.text: Through the reinforcement learning technique, it is possible to perform thousands of simulations in parallel where robots can interact freely in space and thus refine the neural networks that govern their movements to achieve specific goals.
For example, the AI can suggest possible causes or solutions for a non-conformity, which will then be confirmed by the operator

This evolution of the production model also involves a change in the skills and abilities of the staff, especially for Blue Collar workers, who will transition from an operational role to one of controlling automated tools.
quotes.section: Sec. 3 Digital Twin: Pillars, p. 1140 (PDF page 4)
